about: Todole app screenshots. device 'phone' = iPhone, 1179x2406, status bar removed; device 'desktop' = web app, about 1880x910 (16 is 991x902). Private folder, task and project names were replaced with neutral ones and the typo 'Emplyoee' fixed at the owner's request. Describe only what is visible here. 'hold': true = do not use until the owner confirms.

screenshots.shows: A task opened from the Inbox ('Check list') with its date and time range (Sun, 1 Nov, 13:00-23:05) in red, notes with start and end time, a priority flag button, and buttons for labels, a checklist and attachments. In the background list: a task 'Client call'.

The add sheet with a Task/Project switch, a new task 'Appointment', an 'Add notes...' field, the hint 'Try "tomorrow 5pm p1 #project @label"', and chips for Inbox, Today, Reminders and Priority. Keyboard open.
features: natural language dates and tags (per the hint)

screenshots.shows: A Templates page with search and categories Featured, Work, Personal, Education. Work: 'Client management' (board, 'Organize your work with clients from first call to...') and 'Meeting agenda' (list, 'Run a focused meeting and capture the follow-...'). Personal: 'Fitness plan' and 'Grocery list'.
The Dashboard with an options menu open: Search, Select projects, New folder, List view, Sort, Completed projects, Archived projects, Manage folders, Templates, Open menu.

Smart lists (Search, Inbox 19, Today 21, Upcoming, Filters & Labels), folders 'Todole' and 'Client work', and projects 4/5: Client management (starred, 15), Project kickoff (6), Research project (12).
Notifications: 'Todole shared a task with you' (voice note, 16 Nov) and 'Todole shared a project with you' (Employee Management, 16 Nov).

Productivity page: 21 completed tasks, Daily / Weekly / Karma tabs, daily goal 0/5 tasks ('What's first on your list?', Edit goals), daily streak 0 days (longest 1 day), completed in the last 7 days chart.

Settings: Upgrade to Pro banner, Productivity 0/5 today, Appearance, Language (English), Notifications, Integrations, App lock ('Require Face ID / fingerprint to open Todole', on), Export my data (CSV, JSON).
features: app lock with Face ID or fingerprint
export data as CSV or JSON

screenshots.shows: Focus Stats: today's sessions 0, today's focus 0m, total sessions 3, total focus 50m, focus records (No task 40m; Project kickoff 5m twice), details by Today / Week / Month / Custom.
A Pomo / Stopwatch focus timer at 5:00 with a Start button, selected project 'Project kickoff' (6 open tasks), and project overview 50% complete, 6 out of 12 tasks.
Day view for Tuesday 24 November 2026 with an hourly timeline, a current-time marker at 03:35, and an all-day task 'Home decor' (Today).
Monthly calendar for November 2026 with dots on days that have tasks, today (24) highlighted, and the day's task list below ('Home decor', Today).
Weekly calendar strip (23-29 November) with today highlighted and the day's task 'Home decor' below.

Dashboard ('Good morning, Saif', Tuesday 24 November) with My projects, folder chips (All 5, Todole, Client work), and project cards: Client management (15 tasks, 5 sections), Project kickoff ('Scope, plan and launch a new piece of work', 6 tasks), Research project (12 tasks), Grocery list (12 tasks), Employee Management (6 tasks).

Inbox list (Tasks / Projects switch) with tasks and dates: Check list (1 Nov, 13:00-23:05), Client call (3 Nov), Client call (4 Nov), voice note (16 Nov, with an image attached), Client call (6, 7, 8 Nov).

A command palette (Ctrl K) over the Profile settings page: a search box 'Search tasks, projects and labels, or type a command'; Go to: Today, Inbox, Upcoming, Calendar, Focus, All projects, Settings; Commands: Add a task (shortcut Q), Start a focus session, Switch to the dark theme; keyboard hints to move, open and close.

Focus statistics with Day / Week / Month / Custom and 'Export as CSV': today's sessions and focus, total sessions and focus, a details chart, a weekly trends chart with daily average, today's timeline (06:00-22:00), and recent karma ('Completed a task' +2).

Focus page with Pomodoro / Stopwatch, a 25:00 '25-minute Pomo' timer with Start, 'Then a 5-minute break · a long break after 4', 'Focus on a task or project', and Today stats: sessions, focus time, time saved ('Focus on a project to compare with your esti...'), this week, records with 'Add record'.
